name: jev-gates
description: Calibrated gates for Claude Code, judged by TypeSafe Jev: rules, scope, intent, prompt check, bash, done, claims, proof, and commit honesty.

scripts.demo:rules: asciinema rec --overwrite --window-size 108x16 --command 'node demo/run.mjs rules' demo/out/rules.cast && agg --cols 108 --rows 16 --theme monokai --font-size 16 --idle-time-limit 3 --last-frame-duration 4 demo/out/rules.cast demo/out/jev-gates-rules.gif
scripts.demo:scope: asciinema rec --overwrite --window-size 108x14 --command 'node demo/run.mjs scope' demo/out/scope.cast && agg --cols 108 --rows 14 --theme monokai --font-size 16 --idle-time-limit 3 --last-frame-duration 4 demo/out/scope.cast demo/out/jev-gates-scope.gif
scripts.demo:intent: asciinema rec --overwrite --window-size 108x14 --command 'node demo/run.mjs intent' demo/out/intent.cast && agg --cols 108 --rows 14 --theme monokai --font-size 16 --idle-time-limit 3 --last-frame-duration 4 demo/out/intent.cast demo/out/jev-gates-intent.gif
scripts.demo:done: asciinema rec --overwrite --window-size 108x20 --command 'node demo/run.mjs done' demo/out/done.cast && agg --cols 108 --rows 20 --theme monokai --font-size 16 --idle-time-limit 3 --last-frame-duration 4 demo/out/done.cast demo/out/jev-gates-done.gif
scripts.demo:claims: asciinema rec --overwrite --window-size 108x16 --command 'node demo/run.mjs claims' demo/out/claims.cast && agg --cols 108 --rows 16 --theme monokai --font-size 16 --idle-time-limit 3 --last-frame-duration 4 demo/out/claims.cast demo/out/jev-gates-claims.gif
scripts.demo:commit: asciinema rec --overwrite --window-size 108x16 --command 'node demo/run.mjs commit' demo/out/commit.cast && agg --cols 108 --rows 16 --theme monokai --font-size 16 --idle-time-limit 3 --last-frame-duration 4 demo/out/commit.cast demo/out/jev-gates-commit.gif
scripts.demo:all: asciinema rec --overwrite --window-size 108x60 --command 'node demo/run.mjs all' demo/out/all.cast && agg --cols 108 --rows 60 --theme monokai --font-size 16 --idle-time-limit 3 --last-frame-duration 4 demo/out/all.cast demo/out/jev-gates.gif && ffmpeg -v error -y -i demo/out/jev-gates.gif -movflags faststart -pix_fmt yuv420p -vf 'scale=trunc(iw/2)*2:trunc(ih/2)*2' demo/out/jev-gates.mp4
scripts.demo:render: npm run demo:all && npm run demo:rules && npm run demo:scope && npm run demo:intent && npm run demo:done && npm run demo:claims && npm run demo:commit
